WITH target_post AS (
  SELECT p.post_id FROM n_posts p
  WHERE p.post_id = :post_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND fn_can_view_post(:viewer_id, p.post_id) = 1
), visible AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.username, u.avatar_url, u.display_name, u.bio, u.location, u.website,
         u.is_verified, u.followers_count, u.following_count, u.posts_count, u.likes_count,
         l.created_at, l.post_like_id
  FROM target_post p JOIN n_post_likes l ON l.post_id = p.post_id
  JOIN v_user_profile_public u ON u.user_id = l.user_id AND u.is_active = 1
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM n_user_blocks b
    WHERE (b.user_id = :viewer_id AND b.target_user_id = u.user_id)
       OR (b.user_id = u.user_id AND b.target_user_id = :viewer_id)
  )
), ranked AS (
  SELECT v.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY v.created_at DESC, v.post_like_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM visible v
)
SELECT COALESCE(r.user_id, 0) AS user_id, r.username, r.avatar_url, r.display_name, r.bio, r.location,
       r.website, r.is_verified, r.followers_count, r.following_count, r.posts_count, r.likes_count,
       'offline' AS online_status, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_seen_at,
       CASE WHEN r.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN fn_get_user_relationship(:viewer_id, r.user_id) END AS relation,
       totals.total
FROM target_post p CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM visible) totals
LEFT JOIN ranked r ON r.rn BETWEEN :start_row AND :end_row
ORDER BY r.rn
